name: Proxmox management
description: Atena connects to your Proxmox VE hypervisor: status of nodes, virtual machines and containers, start, shutdown, reboot and snapshots, by voice too.
capabilities: Status of nodes, VMs and LXC containers with CPU and RAM
Start, shutdown, force stop, reboot, suspend and resume
Voice commands protected by face and voice recognition
Access with API token or username and password
